[title30][sentence]
The ropes hanging down from the
armatures have slackened since you
lowered the boat to street level.  They
hang loosely below, but because
of the hopeless condition of the winches,
you cannot pull them back up.
[title17][sentence]\nThe ends of the heavy rope are secured\nto the winches.

[title21][sentence]
A padlock secures the control box door
closed.  The control box is showing signs
of advanced decay, but the padlock,
unfortunately, is not.

[title19][sentence]
The control box is secured by
a large padlock, you are going
to need a key.

[title25][sentence]
Rust has almost completely destroyed
the innards of the control box.  You are
not going to be able to do any more with
this pile of corroded junk.

[title27][sentence]
Once you removed the lock,
the cover of the control box fell off.
Being composed mostly of rust, the
release lever crumbled in front of you.
This caused the winches to release their
grip on the ropes, sending the boat
crashing down onto the street below.

[title21][sentence]
The buildings below include a large dome with
a statue in front of it, a small shopping strip,
a seafood restaurant, and a few private residences.

[title22][sentence]
"Polly's Pleasure Dome."  It sounds
like your kind of place.  The statue
in front of it catches your attention.

[title26][sentence]
The enormous statue stands in front
of "Polly's Pleasure Dome" and is
definitely in the correct proportions.
Despite a missing right arm she still
manages to keep your interest for
several minutes.  You suddenly wish
you were fifty feet tall.
[title22][sentence]\nConstruction and maintenance crews must keep\nequipment in there.

[title25][sentence]
You aren't planning to do any repairs
on the expressway, so you don't bother
with the maintenance building.

[title29][sentence]
This waist-high wall must help prevent
people and vehicles from accidentally
driving or falling down to the next level.

[title27][sentence]
The support obediently concerns itself
with its one goal in life:  keeping the
expressway suspended above the city.

[title32][sentence]
This city so vast that getting lost
it would be a bad idea.  You decide
to remain in sight of the car at all
times.

[title25][sentence]
The street you are standing on parallels
the edge of this level of the city.  Over the fence you
see another section of the city far below.
A small, noisy dog stands yapping in front
of an auto repair shop here.

[title25][sentence]
The street you are standing on parallels
the edge of this level of the city.  Over the
fence you see another section of the city
far below.  There is an auto repair shop
here on this corner, with a broken window.

[title25][sentence]
The small wall beneath the fence must
be designed to help manually driven
vehicles from falling off this level of the
city.

[title22][sentence]
The low fence must be here to keep people
from falling off the edge of this level.  That
would be one nasty fall.
[title16][sentence]\nThe MLV that brought you here hasn't\nchanged since you stepped out of it.

[title25][sentence]
The plastic cover sealing the manhole
leads you to believe that it was not
meant to be opened again.  You
assume it was used during construction
of the city.
[title18][sentence]\nThis must be that noisy dog's lavatory.

[title14][sentence]
The sign contains an arrow pointing
straight down.  Your inability to
understand its meaning frustrates
you.
[title25][sentence]\nThe broken window adds to the pervasive\nrun-down feeling of the neighborhood.

[title22][sentence]
The wide garage door is closed and locked.
The rubber skid marks on the sidewalk
in front of the door lead  you to believe that
something other than MLV's were serviced here.

[title20][sentence]
The sidewalk ends at a barrier in
one direction, and continues on into
the city in the other.

[title25][sentence]
Now you have it figured out!  This place
must have serviced the kind of vehicles
that use rubber tires, and ride directly
on the road.  Why else would there be
skid marks and an air hose?  This guy
must have been into antiques.

[title25][sentence]
You gather from the sign that the shop
was owned by someone named 'Abdul'.
The large door is closed and locked, but there is a
smaller door around the side.

[title25][sentence]
You gather from the sign that the shop
was owned by someone named 'Abdul'.
The large door is closed and locked, but there is a
smaller door around the side, which appears
to be guarded by the small noisy dog.
[title18][sentence]\nThe side entrance appears to be open.

[title27][sentence]
The side entrance unfortunately lies
on the other side of that small, loud,
obnoxious dog.

[title30][sentence]
He looks hungry.  His high-pitched
yapping noises are about as appealing to
your ears as fingers on a chalkboard.
[title21][sentence]\nHe's already talking to you.  Is it his\nfault you don't understand him?

[title22][sentence]
The barricade looks temporary.  The
street over there may have been
under construction.

[title29][sentence]
Wow!  Now THAT is a mean little pooch!
Perhaps you should not have gotten so
close to him.

[title29][sentence]
You have decided not to stray too
far from the car.  Getting lost in a
city this large would not be any fun.

[title22][sentence]
You give the door a quick yank.  It
doesn't budge, confirming your belief
that it is locked.

[title18][sentence]
The shop you are standing in reminds
you a great deal of a friend's shop back
on Umbilica IV.  Then again, these parts
probably aren't as hot.

[title25][sentence]
The ship you are standing in reminds
you a great deal of a friend's shop back
on Umbilica IV.  That obnoxious dog
seems to have found you again.  His
annoying bark is beginning to grate on
your nerves.

[title21][sentence]
The shop you are standing in reminds
you a great deal of a friend's shop back
on Umbilica IV.  Except maybe that
your friend doesn't have too many
flattened animals hanging around his
place.

[title22][sentence]
Stray parts can be seen everywhere
in here.  Not being a mechanical kind
of guy they are useless to you.
[title21][sentence]\nYour car is running just fine.  You\nhave no need for auto parts.
[title20][sentence]\nGrease and oil stains discolor\nthe garage floor in many places.

[title21][sentence]
Grease and oil stains discolor
the garage floor in many places.
There is also a fresh pink stain
beneath the car on the lift.

[title19][sentence]
Considering the probably age of these
ribs, you decide to avoid them.  They
could present an olfactory hazard.

[title21][sentence]
Blech!  Double-blech!  Those ribs
are so old they could probably be
carbon dated.  Haven't you noticed
that even that annoying dog wont
touch them?

[title20][sentence]
Blech!  Double-blech!  Those ribs
are so old they could probably be
carbon dated.  Stay away!

[title27][sentence]
This button is connected to the
car lift.  It is marked "UP" in
greasy yellow letters.

[title27][sentence]
This button is connected to the
car lift.  It is marked "DOWN"
in greasy yellow letters.

[title27][sentence]
A few dirty, smelly old oil rags occupy
the trash can.  Nothing else of interest
catches your eye.
[title22][sentence]\nObviously, Abdul's taste in calendars\nmatches yours almost exactly.
[title19][sentence]\nThe storage box is probably for\norganizing small car parts.

[title21][sentence]
The storage box is probably for
organizing small car parts, such as
the rearview mirror sitting on it.
[title21][sentence]\nYou wouldn't have any use for the\ncar parts inside this storage box.

[title26][sentence]
You pick up the rearview mirror
and stuff it in your pocket.  A passing
glance at it reveals that you desperately
need a shave.

[title25][sentence]
This looks like any other rearview
mirror.  It's about a hundred times
smaller than the one on the Slippery Pig.

[title29][sentence]
Only the bottom drawer of the toolbox
is open.  You see a wrench and a tube
of cement in an open drawer.  There
is a jack sitting on top of the tool box.
[title20][sentence]\nExcept for the jack sitting atop it, the\ntoolbox is uninteresting.

[title27][sentence]
The tool box contains only highly specialized
MLV repair accessories.  You wouldn't even
begin to know how to use them.

[title21][sentence]
This is great stuff.  You can use polycement
to fix almost anything.  One of the maneuvering
thrusters on the Pig was attached with this stuff.

[title22][sentence]
First you verify that the cap is on tight.  The
one time you forgot to do this you ended up
with an empty tube forever attached to the
inside of your pocket.  The tube is still
malleable, so the polycement must still be
fresh.  You slip it in your pocket.

[title21][sentence]
Cans of auto fluids and
lubricants line the walls.
Lighting up in here would
probably not be a good idea.

[title25][sentence]
The car lift allows the mechanic to work
beneath a car while standing up.  This
is convenient for mechanics who are more
than a centimeter tall.  Currently, there is
a car attached to the lift.
[title22][sentence]\nThese aren't car parts.  Abdul must\nhave been somewhat eccentric.

[title25][sentence]
That annoying animal is back.  The little
land-piranha is hungrily eyeing you again,
and you are amazed by the speed at which his
six little legs can carry him.

[title27][sentence]
The orange danger zone painted on the
floor serves as a warning.  When cars
are lowered, this is an unsafe place to
be standing.

[title16][sentence]
You may want to have your
eyes checked.  The car is already
down on the floor.

[title22][sentence]
You momentarily confuse the lift
as it tries to figure out how to lift
the car higher than 'all-the-way-up'.

[title25][sentence]
Throwing bones around in this empty
auto shop would be a serious waste
of time.
[title22][sentence]\nThe orange danger zone is\ncurrently occupied by the car.
[title18][sentence]\nThis used to be an obnoxious\nlittle dog.  Now it isn't.

[title21][sentence]
The wretched thing barks no more!
His next and final offense will be
aromatic.

[title20][sentence]
Yech!  Leave that gooey stuff here.
If you're THAT hungry, go get yourself
another twinkifruit.

[title25][sentence]
A large marquee marks the entrance to
a video store on the corner.  You also see
a very interesting statue and a portable
toilet.
[title20][sentence]\nThe street continues around the corner\nnear the large statue.

[title22][sentence]
An interesting aroma emanates from
the portable toilet.  It's a safe bet that
no one has cleaned or emptied it
in a century or so.

[title29][sentence]
It looks as though the video store was
trying to create an 'opening night'
atmosphere.  You are more
familiar with the kind of video store
that is only open at night.

[title18][sentence]
The billboard advertises a new hormone
supplement.  The men who lived here must
have wanted to be extremely male.

[title29][sentence]
The statue catches your interest.  The statue
continues to catch your interest.  You stare
at the statue for a few minutes.  You decide
to do something else before you need a cold shower.
[title18][sentence]\nThis is the car you arrived in.

[title25][sentence]
The new stand must have carried almost a hundred
different magazines and two different city newspapers.
You can see a few of the headlines: "Women believed
working on biologic weapons - Defense Council concerned",
 and "New residential section to be powered up today".
[title22][sentence]\nThe  sliding doors are locked.  It seems\nyou need a key to gain entry.

[title21][sentence]
The sliding door are now unlocked.

	"20 percent off sign" should all become "BANNER"

[title21][sentence]
There's no question about it.  That has 
got to be the ugliest kid you have ever
seen.

[title27][sentence]
"Civilization - The Movie".  You wonder
if the movie could possibly be as good
as the game.
[title29][sentence]\nYou grew up watching Harpo, Groucho, and Karl.

[title27][sentence]
The monitor on the counter is playing some new release
which you find uninteresting in its complete lack of sex and
violence.  The monitor hanging from the shelf is playing
a horror video called "The Return of Slache".  You are
not interested in watching this film.
[title22][sentence]\nYou cannot see outside because the\ndoors are closed.

[title30][sentence]
The store is loaded with all kinds of videos.  You
also notice a couple viewing monitors and a phone
handset.
[title26][sentence]\nYou grab the handset off of the base unit.

[title24][sentence]
This is the most pompous logo you have
ever seen, with the possible exception
of the Synex Communications logo back
on Umbilica IV.

[title32][sentence]
It seems that famous stars have come from far
and wide to have their footprints immortalized
in cement.  Something in the back of your
mind tells you this is not an original idea.
You don't recognize any of the names.

[title25][sentence]
It seems famous stars have come from far
and wide to have their footprints immortalized
in cement.  Something in the back of your
mind tells you this is not an original idea.
The only name you recognize here is Bruce's.
Hmmm.  It looks like he was wearing high-heels.
[title18][sentence]\nA monitor and a telephone sit on the bright\nred counter.
[title21][sentence]\nThe antenna informs you that this is an\nold-style radio frequency cordless telephone.

[title27][sentence]
It looks like someone waited too long before
putting his foot in the cement.  Phew!  He
must have had gangrene.
[title26][sentence]\nPlease.  Give yourself a break.  Surely\nyou can think of a better souvenir.
[title29][sentence]\nThe spotlights illuminate Civilization - The Movie.
[title21][sentence]\nThis is the part of the telephone you\npick up and talk into, Einstein.

[title27][sentence]
This part of the phone sits on the counter
and holds the handset.  While in the handset
is in the cradle the batteries charge, and
the phone can ring for incoming calls.

[title22][sentence]
The slot provides a handy method
of returning rented videos.  You notice
that the return bin is empty.
[title30][sentence]\nDoes the [noun1] look like\na movie to you?
[title25][sentence]\nThis place has thousands of titles.  Too\nbad you don't own a player any more.

[title19][sentence]
Some guy wants to pay you a hundred
thousand galactars for a vase and you
want to watch a movie!  Get a life!

[title18][sentence]
You place the handset firmly into
the cradle.  The charging light
blinks red.

[title26][sentence]
That's your trusty command chair, in
which you have spent most of your waking
hours for the past few years.  From the
command chair, all of the ship's systems
are at your disposal, although since the
crash-landing most of them are probably
*ready* for disposal.

[title22][sentence]
The bad news:  You have 'landed' underwater, your ship has
been rendered useless, and it's a safe bet that big ugly ship
is still looking for you.
The good news:  You just made your last payment on this ship
so it's yours free and clear!

[title29][sentence]
The inner hull of the your ship is made
entirely of tufstufnium. The outer hull,
consisting mostly of crudnium and some duct tape,
unfortunately didn't do too well during reentry.

[title25][sentence]
Possibly the only thing your 
ex-interior decorator did that
doesn't cause you to double over and violently 
heave your guts out.  YOU are the fuzzy dice man.

[title22][sentence]
While observing that your nostril hairs need a good clipping, 
 you notice a green glob of spinach 
between your teeth.  The odd thing is you haven't eaten spinach in 
two weeks.  If only there was a 20-gauge high tension wire lying
around that you could use as a flossing utensil.

[title25][sentence]
Wincing at the "Drapes Of Wrath", you swear
to use them to light the fire when
you burn your ex-decorator at the
stake.

[title30][sentence]
You try desperately to recall the name
of the woman who welded that there one
fateful night.

[title29][sentence]
This view screen monitors many of the
ships systems, including any remote sensor
probes.  You will need to sit in the command
chair to use it properly.

[title21][sentence]
That's the emergency escape hatch (EMERGENCY 
being the key word here).  It is activated by
explosive bolts and opening it under present
circumstances would flood this cockpit in seconds flat.
No oxygen mask pops out of the ceiling and you can't use 
your seat as a flotation device so your best bet is to try
the main airlock, since it is apparently still clear of mud.

[title27][sentence]
Even if you were to put on your rebreather first,
opening the emergency escape hatch would prove to 
be an unhealthy maneuver, since there's a rather large
amount of water on the other side that's just waiting
to rush in and flatten you against the far bulkhead.
The escape hatch is really only intended for use
in outer space or in an atmosphere.  In your
present circumstances, your best bet is the main airlock.

[title26][sentence]
The target computer reports that it has
calculated firm firing solutions on three
nearby belligerent guppies and is now 
running a full threat assessment on the 
suspicious-looking seaweed bank up ahead.

[title27][sentence]
Imagine that.  After plummeting 40,000 feet at an
extremely high velocity and landing with the force
of a 5,000 megaton neutron bomb the control panel 
is damaged.  Worst of all, the warranty expired last week.

[title30][sentence]
The navigation computer is capable of guiding
you through the interstellar void, predicting
the folds of hyperspace, circumnavigating stray
asteroids, maintaining planetary orbits, and even
descending through the eight classes of terrestrial
and semi-terrestrial atmosphere.  Unfortunately, it
doesn't seem to have a "navigate through ten feet
of sludge at the bottom of the ocean with your
engines blown off" setting, so there's a good
chance that it won't be of much help to you now.

[title24][sentence]
The engineering controls allow you to monitor the
flow of power to the Dimensional Rift Engines
as you prepare to translate the ship into hyperspace.
Right now the panel is completely dead, so something
must be wrong with your engines - like you don't 
have them anymore.

[title30][sentence]
The weapons status display informs you that
your ship's weaponry has been recently
removed by a rather violent particle beam.

[title32][sentence]
Although your rear deflector screens were
completely obliterated in the space battle,
your front deflectors survived long enough
to preserve you through atmospheric reentry.
All deflector systems are now down, however,
since their compartments have been flooded.

[title30][sentence]
That probe landed on a wet beach.  It
must have shorted out.  Well, at least you
still have the Spaceboy magazines.

causing your hair to stick straight up, bringing about a

Your ex-interior decorator gave you specific orders
to keep your filthy rotten hands off the lovely window
treatments.  What kind of man would dare
tamper with such luxurious cascading fabric.  Besides, 
you're allergic to chintz.

marine life will not be frightened by such an odd-looking creature.

room.  In front of it are controls and monitors for
